description: This file defines the class TemplateCurrencyId, a specialized template class for handling currency ID fields within a SuiteCRM module. It extends the TemplateId class to customize behavior for currency ID fields, including their definition and persistence logic.

classes.name: TemplateCurrencyId
classes.description: A class extending TemplateId to implement a currency ID specific field, with custom size, type, and methods for field definition, save, and delete operations.

methods.name: get_field_def
methods.description: Returns an array defining the field's properties, including type, database type, visibility in studio, and associated functions.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the field definition if it does not already exist.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the field if there is no other currency field present.
